svg.aria-label: How a birth chart is proven right: five independent layers
svg.title: How a birth chart is proven right: five independent layers

g.text: How a birth chart is proven right: five independent layers
No layer trusts the one below it. A failure in any layer says which kind of disagreement it is.
1 · Mathematics is trusted only after it reproduces the JPL kernel
2 · The same charts are checked against a second, independent engine
3 · Then against what real sites and published constants print, with tolerance for rounding
4 · A disagreement beyond tolerance blocks the release
5 · Derived values are recomputed from the longitudes by a separate implementation
6 · Any mismatch is a bug in one of the two implementations, never ignored
